archetypes.name: Curious Listener
archetypes.blurb: You're just peeking in, letting a soft voice keep you company. Nothing has taken hold yet - but you keep coming back to listen.

archetypes.name: Trance Dabbler
archetypes.blurb: You've felt the pull. The slowing, the sinking, the quiet. You like how it feels to let your thoughts go soft for a while.

archetypes.name: Bambi in Training
archetypes.blurb: The triggers are starting to work. Good Girl warms you, the persona is forming, and obeying is starting to feel nicer than thinking.

archetypes.name: Deep Bambi
archetypes.blurb: You drop fast now. The triggers pull you under, the old self fades when Bambi wakes, and going blank feels like coming home.

archetypes.name: Gone Bambi
archetypes.blurb: There's barely anyone left but Bambi, and she wouldn't have it any other way. Empty, giggly, obedient - exactly where she belongs.
